facts.fact: Advance tax for Tax Year 2026-27 (FY 2026-27) arises and is paid under the Income-tax Act, 2025; the first instalment was due on 15 June 2026
facts.quote: The first instalment of advance tax for tax year 2026 -27 (Financial year 2026 -27) is due to be paid on 15th June 2026.

facts.fact: Section 408 of the Income-tax Act, 2025 sets the advance tax instalments (four instalments in the financial year)
facts.quote: financial year and the due date of each instalment and the amount of such instalment shall be as specified in the Table below.

facts.fact: Instalment 1: on or before 15 June, at least 15% of the advance tax
facts.quote: On or before Not less than 15% of such advance tax. the 15th June.

facts.fact: Instalment 2: on or before 15 September, at least 45% (cumulative)
facts.quote: before the 15th September. Not less than 45% of such advance tax, as reduced by the amount, if any, paid in the earlier instalment.

facts.fact: Instalment 3: on or before 15 December, at least 75% (cumulative); as of October 2026 this is the next instalment (15 December 2026)
facts.quote: before the 15th December. Not less than 75% of such advance tax, as reduced by the amount or amounts, if any, paid in the earlier instalment or instalments.

facts.fact: Instalment 4: on or before 15 March, 100% of the advance tax
facts.quote: the 15th March. The whole amount of such advance tax, as reduced by the amount or amounts, if any, paid in the earlier instalment or instalments.

facts.fact: Presumptive-scheme taxpayers (section 58) pay the whole advance tax in one instalment by 15 March (section 408(2))
facts.quote: Under the new Act, assessees opting for the presumptive taxation scheme (Section 58) must discharge their entire advance tax liability in a single instalment on or before 15 March of the relevant financial year, in accordance with Section 408(2).

facts.fact: Advance tax is payable only if the tax for the year is Rs 10,000 or more (section 404)
facts.quote: Under Section 404 of the Income Tax Act, 2025, advance tax is payable if the amount of tax payable during the year, computed under the advance tax provisions, is Rs. 10,000 or more.

facts.fact: Shortfall interest: section 424 (old 234B) at 1% per month or part of a month
facts.quote: Interest under Section 424 (corresponding to Section 234B of old Act) — 1% per month or part of the month for the specified period for failure to pay advance tax or where advance tax paid is less than 90% of assessed tax

facts.fact: Deferment interest: section 425 (old 234C) for deferment of instalments
facts.quote: Interest under Section 425 (corresponding to Section 234C of old Act) — 1% or 3% for the specified period for deferment of advance tax instalments.

facts.fact: In the challan select 'Income Tax Act 2025' for payments for TY 2026-27 onwards
facts.quote: Select “Income Tax Act 2025”, for making payments for TY 2026–27 onwards.

facts.fact: For advance tax on income of April 2026 to March 2027 select Tax Year 2026-27
facts.quote: For advance tax on income earned during April 2026 to March 2027 - taxpayer will select Tax Year 2026 -27.

summary: All advance tax facts confirmed: s.408 table (15/45/75/100% by 15 Jun/Sep/Dec/Mar) from the Income-tax Act, 2025 gazette; s.404, s.408(2), s.424/425 and challan selection from ITD pages.
